race.comment: Another big field but ZALI'S GIFT (5) looks a top chance to get off the mark. Has shown plenty of ability in stakes class last time in and returned with an eye-catching fourth over 1200m at Belmont Park. Fitter and extra trip ideal. Goes close on best. OCEAN REEF (2) is a four-start maiden who looks close to breaking the duck after finishing in the placings at his last couple of runs, most recently when a neck away in second over 1300m at Northam. Patrick Carbery stays on and has three minors while aboard. Likely to feature. PLAYING SOLO (15) is a three-start maiden who resumed from a spell last start and was beaten 3 lengths when seventh over 1200m at Belmont Park. Definite top-three hope with plenty of improvement to come. MYSTIC EMPRESS (10) finished second last time over 1300m at Northam, beaten 11 lengths. Close to a win and drawn for a soft run. PRODUCIMUS (11) is back in trip and will be winding up late.
